implementationNotes: Release-gate obligation recorded 2026-09-29 (DEC-50, ADR 0018, WCLI-38). The obligation is now step 1 of docs/runbooks/cutting-a-ward-release.md, so whoever cuts the release meets it without rediscovering WCLI-38.
